target_definitions.scope: political power, rule, state leadership and de facto governance
warfare, military command and armed leadership
natural science, mathematics, medicine, astronomy and formal or empirical inquiry
engineering, invention, architecture, applied technology and construction
commerce, finance, enterprise and economic systems or thought when that is the representative historical identity
philosophy, history, language, literature, social thought, visual arts, music and performing arts
religious leadership, theology, faith traditions and religious reform
exploration, navigation, geographic discovery, expeditions and frontier travel

legacy.retirement_rule: Do not rename knowledge to science until every remaining knowledge Person has been reviewed and is confirmed science-target.

migration.pre_cutover_rule: Persons whose v2 target is science remain temporarily stored as knowledge; only non-science targets move during review units.

science_retained_checkpoint.purpose: durably distinguish reviewed science-target Persons from unresolved legacy knowledge before final cutover
